Over the last hour I rerouted some of the lines on my PCB, added the required footprints, AND started the dreaded README.  Making the readme is my least favorite part. I know that in my last entry I spoke about wanting to redo my project and instead do the MIDI keyboard, but I doubt I would be able to complete the project giving the time left, so I decided to submit the work I have done so far as detailed as possible and to improve on the feedback that will be given by my super Chad evaluator.
